description: One phonetic definition driven with every input shape the dispatch at DefaultStrings:1157-1186 can see: a tagged value from another axis, numbers of several Java types, a boolean, PluralOperands, an explicit null, an absent binding, and no placeholder map at all, plus two raw strings that spell constant names. A resolver IS installed, so no diagnostic here can reduce to 'no resolver'. A second key ('Plain') carries no placeholder and a third ('Gendered') carries a GENDER definition, both for must-not-be-called observations. The plain raw-term and plain tagged-value controls are deliberately NOT re-authored here; callback-smoke already owns them.
